Meadow sprites reproduce asexually and do not form social or family systems of any kind, though they may spontaneously dance in circles together or click at each other for territory.
Meadow sprites are thought to have the intelligence of a human toddler and love to get into mischief.
Meadow sprites have rather fragile bodies and typically splatter, die, and disappear on impact. Their lifespan usually ranges from 15 to 45 days.
